edition.authority: Second Vatican Council; Pope Paul VI
edition.notes: The official Latin Acta presentation contains numbered paragraphs 1-69 on printed pp. 5-67, followed by the promulgation formula, date, papal and conciliar subscriptions, and notarial attestations through printed p. 71.
edition.title: Constitutio dogmatica de Ecclesia Lumen gentium

passages.context: The Constitution's complete numbered doctrinal text, beginning with paragraph 1 on printed p. 5 and ending with paragraph 69 at the top of printed p. 67 before the promulgation formula.
passages.notes: Paragraph 69 continues onto artifact and printed p. 67. The beginning, numbered sequence, and final boundary were checked against the exact Acta artifact; no complete diplomatic transcription or word-for-word image collation is claimed.
passages.reason: The rights record states that lawful project access to this artifact does not include redistribution from this repository.
passages.rights_basis: The Vatican portal Legal Notes, reviewed 2026-07-23 at https://www.vatican.va/content/vatican/en/legal-notes.html, limit portal content to personal and non-profit viewing and prohibit collection, reproduction, dissemination, or transfer without prior written authorization from the Dicastery for Communication. No repository redistribution permission was established.

work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The Second Vatican Council's Dogmatic Constitution on the Church, solemnly promulgated by Pope Paul VI on 21 November 1964. Edition records distinguish the Latin Acta witness from dated Vatican web delivery states and translations.
work.title: Lumen gentium
